notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.26b
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,



just released a hotfix, that fixes a blocking issue introduced with the last update:

You weren't able to put the nuggets in the box after taking a photo and couldn't proceed.



Sorry for the inconvenience, have fun playing. :)



Cheers,

 Tim

notes.title: And here's Update 1.0.26
notes.notes:
Hi Folks,

some more improvements and fixes for Cantaloupe Chronicle: (might contain mild spoilers)



Added and option to the main menu settings to enable "simple fonts". That will replace the cursive font in the game with a much easier to read black on white font.

Added a dialog hint for the flyer puzzle that you have to write the flyer text yourself. In addition you can't click on the notebook notes to add them to the flyer anymore.

Fixed a bug with the radio lighting up by default

When you take the picture of the nuggets the screen now automatically closes and you're back at the kitchen.

Reduced train sound volume.

Added a Mom hint that you have to copy the flyer

Reduced frequency of idle animation of player character

Improved clarity on some of Mom's hints

When you're supposed to eat breakfest you won't get the "I'm not hungry right now" text from the fridge



That's all,

 enjoy! :)

notes.title: Update 1.0.25 brings more UI improvements, hints and fixes
notes.notes:
Hi there,



after getting so much great feedback from watching streams of the game, I've prepared another update. :) Here's what changed:



 Warning: Might contain mild spoilers 



You can now open the highscore from the arcade cabinet by pressing F1

When you browser through dialog options while no dialog is active the options now don't show a rectangle around them, making it more clear that they are not interactable

Added a hint that when you try to put the empty beer bottle in the pot that you should put it in the steam instead

Made the door frame at home a brighter color so it's harder to miss

Fixed an issue with some characters rotating around randomly over time

Fixed and issue where you would get a hint to get more reed when it was not possible yet

Added a hot spot to the tape recorder

Fixed an issue where taking of sunglasses didn't work

Some various smaller fixes and polishing



Cheers,

 Tim

notes.title: Update 1.0.24 is out now
notes.notes:
Hi again,



another quick update for Cantaloupe Chronicle is already ready to download. The change-log might contain mild spoilers.



Added a second tutorial step for when you pickup the bag

You can now toggle the notebook with the middle mouse button

Added more tips, reactions and Easter eggs

Fixed a bug where you could make cantaloupe nuggets without the cantaloupe ‼️

Various smaller bug fixes



Cheers,

 Tim

notes.title: Update 1.0.23 is available now
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,



I've just released the first update for the game: version 1.0.23. Here's a change-log (might include minor spoilers):

Added a hint that you need to enter the kitchen with the chef inside on day2

Removed rectangle around photo research item to make it clear that you don't add that to the article yourself

Added a description text for the closed town hall when it opens the next day

Added a hint when you try to toast the burger buns

Disabled dialog option buttons and mouse-over effects while dialog is running

Items can now always be used with left-click... right click is only for showing their description

Added another mandatory mon hint that you can look at items with right-click

Made some of mom's hints more clear

Fixed an issue where mom's hint to cut reed came to early

Fixed cars in town being too fast



That's it for now... have fun playing!



Tim
